Class QTileData

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.data.QTileData
public class QTileData extends Object
Represents the static display data associated with a board tile, as loaded from the client-side JSON resource file. Each tile has up to five slots where player pawns can be placed; this class stores the pixel coordinates of each slot, used by the GUI to position pawns correctly on the tile image.
